source: Kenneth R. French Data Library, 'Portfolios Formed on Beta' (CRSP 202608 file; beta from 60 prior monthly returns, Scholes-Williams; value-weighted decile returns, annual Jan-Dec) and 'Fama/French 3 Factors' (RF, Mkt-RF). https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html
fit: weighted least squares (1/se^2) of decile excess / market excess on the decile's median prior beta: ratio = 0.830 + 0.251 beta; normalized so beta 1 earns the market premium
note: premium(beta) = ERP x (c0 + c1 x beta). CAPM would be ERP x beta. Kilian 2026-10-09 16:36Z: replace textbook CAPM with realized return by beta percentile.
